name: Example Package
tagline: An example package used to demonstrate modern Silex metadata, compatibility labels, and depictions.
install_notes: Choose the Roothide build only if your jailbreak environment requires it.
Restart the target app after changing settings.
Import the included demo configuration after first install if you want sample data.
known_conflicts: Do not install together with ExampleConflict.
Disable old legacy hooks before upgrading from rootful-era builds.
replaces_notice: This example replaces the older com.example.package.legacy layout.
Rootful users should migrate to the dedicated compatibility branch instead.

new: Added example metadata for status, release channel, install environments, and compatibility display.
Added demo install notes, conflict warnings, and migration notices.
improve: Improved package depiction examples for modern Silex repos.
